scope: Buyer-interest and conservative turnover assessments for all 127 active collectible-guide rows after promotional exclusions.

rules.demand_means: Expected breadth of buyer interest from known use and collection drivers; it is not a measured sale rate.
rules.turnover_means: Conservative expected speed on a low-population realm; only completed sales can directly confirm turnover.
rules.seasonal_labels_apply: During the named event; use the stated off-season expectation outside that window.
